title: Portfolio container views - cross-boundary dep tree and blocked reasons
description: WHY: cross-boundary state is only trustworthy if inspectable. WHAT: (1) global dep tree renders cross-project dependencies with project name, item title and status from the rollup, and a staleness badge per referenced item; (2) work show on a global container lists cross-project blockers with their typed resolution state (resolved-open, resolved-terminal, stale, unresolved-unlinked, unresolved-missing); (3) the global dashboard initiative view groups containers with progress derived from referenced-item statuses. All read paths degrade gracefully per the fail-soft rules - test explicitly with an unlinked project and a deleted project directory.
acceptanceCriteria: dep tree and work show render cross-project blockers with status, staleness, and typed unresolved states, covered by tests
closedReason: portfolio cross-boundary dep tree views implemented and verified
